power.look: a soft glowing amber panel that fades in when eye contact is made
power.rule: a translucent screen of text appears above each person's head when you look them in the eye

science.claim: The thoughts show only what people are consciously hiding.
science.working: Narrative rule, not a scientific claim. The twist reveals that everyone consciously hides their true thoughts, making the power a mirror of social pretense rather than a window to raw honesty.

script.text: You look at a stranger. Their thought: hungry.
You look at your boss. Their thought: fire me.
You look at your best friend. Their thought: coffee. Always coffee.
You look at the bus driver. Their thought: five more minutes.
Everywhere you look, the truth is just there. No more guessing.
You look at your teacher. Their thought: don't ask me.
What if you could read anyone's thoughts?
But here's the catch. The thoughts only show what people are consciously hiding from you, every single day.

script.beat: 5 the cliffhanger (the person hiding the most)
script.text: And the person hiding the most is standing right in front of you right now, smiling. Part one.
